thread:
anya: Quick check — status on console observability roadmap items that touch other teams? I'm specifically trying to reconcile dashboards + tracing hooks + error-analysis views with retention milestone for next sprint. Who owns the final rollout plan?

miguel: I can give a quick snapshot. Dashboards: baseline set, needs final service-mapping from eng-runtime (blocked on runtime tagging). Tracing hooks: PR open, needs eng-ml signoff for sampling changes. Error-analysis: prototype ready, waiting for storage retention config from eng-infra.

sophia: Tracing hooks PR -> https://git.redwood/sr/4523 merged to staging, sampling flag toggle added. There's one perf regression in tail-latency when sampling=1. I'm investigating.

kevin: Retention milestone question — current plan is 30d hot, 90d cold. Eng-infra estimated additional storage cost ~+$4k/mo if we keep 90d cold. Can we reduce to 60d cold to hit budget? @sophia who would need to sign off on data model changes?

sophia: @kevin I can sign off on the model changes as long as the schema change is limited to TTL policy and doesn't alter the trace envelope. For the sampling perf I mentioned, lowering the sampling window helps.

miguel: To clarify owners: dashboards -> anya (frontend + queries), tracing hooks -> sophia (instrumentation) + eng-ml for sampling logic, retention & storage -> kevin + eng-infra. Does that work?

eng-infra-bot: FYI: schema-migration job `trace-ttl-rollout` scheduled for 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC. Maintenance window ~30m. See: https://infra.ops/trace-ttl-rollout.

kevin: That window works. For canary, suggest `canary-window: 24h` after migration before widening TTL. Also need a rollback plan — add `trace-ttl-rollout --dry-run` to the playbook.

anya: Good notes. Action items: 1) sophia — post perf regression root cause by EOD, include perf numbers; 2) kevin + eng-infra — post cost delta for 60d vs 90d cold by tomorrow; 3) miguel — update sprint board and mark owners; 4) I'll draft the rollout checklist with canary + rollback and ping legal/compliance for retention signoff.

sophia: Quick snippet for how I'm measuring tail latency:

```sql
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 95) as p95, percentile(latency_ms, 99) as p99
FROM traces
WHERE service = 'console' AND ts >= now() - interval '1 hour';
```

sophia: Early numbers: p99 up ~12% with sampling=1 on staging. With sampling=0.5 p99 is back down ~4%. Will post detailed trace flame graphs after instrumenting extra timers.

kevin: Thanks. Once we have the cost numbers I'll call the retention decision; if 60d meets SLOs and saves $$, prefer that.

anya: Perfect — I'll turn this into a checklist and tag the owners in the sprint card. If anyone can't meet the EOD/Tomorrow asks, reply here. :thumbsup:
